articles.title: Congress hits Polymarket and Kalshi with a massive insider trading probe
articles.snippet: Rep. James Comer is demanding internal records from the prediction market CEOs, warning that government employees could be using classified information to make “huge profits”.

articles.title: Bitcoin left behind in the geopolitical melee
CFTC officials who questioned prediction markets were suspended: NYT
articles.snippet: A New York Times investigation found that senior CFTC officials who raised concerns about Polymarket, Crypto.com and Gemini were suspended and pushed out.

articles.title: ECB pushes back on euro stablecoin proposals, citing financial stability risks
articles.snippet: The ECB warned EU finance ministers that expanding euro stablecoin issuance could weaken bank lending and complicate monetary policy.

articles.title: US House lawmakers launch probe into Kalshi, Polymarket insider trading
articles.snippet: Representative James Comer asked CEOs of two major prediction market companies for information on their responses to insider trading after “suspiciously timed trades” related to US military actions against Iran.
